g.text: Different estimators: segmented LPSD and whole-record FFTW power averaging
Bars and numbers: medians. Whiskers: observed minimum–maximum, not confidence intervals.
Float64 input; PSD output float32; periodic Kaiser PSLL = 200 dB; FFTW ESTIMATE; no padding.
Raw FFT excludes preprocessing. Prepared FFTW reuses plan/window/grid; fresh-plan FFTW includes their setup.
All timed LPSD API calls prepare their own windows and coefficients. Shared-host CPU frequency was not controlled.
